title: SessionExport
description: Exported LiveSub session cue log for judges and evaluation.

session_id.description: Unique session identifier for the video playback.

video_url.description: Full URL to the YouTube video.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the log was exported.

playback_time.description: Current video playback time (s) at time of export.

total_cues.description: Total number of subtitle cues logged in this session.
